cohort: Neonates admitted to the NICU at Shimoga Institute of Medical Sciences, Shimoga between November 2020 and November 2021 with clinically suspected late onset sepsis.
finding: Procalcitonin had a sensitivity of 78.57% and a specificity of 77.78% for diagnosing late-onset sepsis at a cutoff value of 0.2 ng/mL.
